command: import sys,json; from pathlib import Path; sys.path.insert(0,sys.argv[1]); from train_retrieval import MODEL_ID,REVISION,MODEL_FILES,WEIGHTS_SHA,file_sha256; from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download; p=Path(snapshot_download(MODEL_ID,revision=REVISION,allow_patterns=MODEL_FILES,cache_dir=sys.argv[2],token=False)); assert file_sha256(p/"model.safetensors")==WEIGHTS_SHA; print(json.dumps({"model_id":MODEL_ID,"revision":REVISION,"weight_sha256":WEIGHTS_SHA}))
